text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my. It looks like I'm breaking out...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I guess I might've overdone it with my
weight
adjustment.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But still... is there anything more
delicious than
some chocolate after a
diet?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, don't even think about it. I'm
going to
give myself a craving.
Although...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Nope. No more chocolate until my
cheeks have
cleared up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute's skin trouble has got her
down.
